issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

action.description: Boolean {@link PartiallyAppliedAction} that tracks the desired indicator of the {@link App.Node}.

timeout.description:
Timeout specification for the {@link #action}.
If the action does not complete within this time, the probe will be considered as unsuccessful.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe.
